description: This file contains unit tests for the Analytics component, specifically testing event sending, event mapping, and server communication within the L2Tests framework. It includes mock classes, test setup, and test cases for verifying event queuing, mapping, and server interactions.

classes.name: ServerMock
classes.description: A mock server class that sets up a TCP socket, listens for incoming connections, receives data, and responds with HTTP status codes. Used to simulate server interactions during tests.

classes.name: AnalyticsTest
classes.description: A test fixture class derived from L2TestMocks, setting up the environment for testing the Analytics component, including mock expectations and service activation.

methods.name: AnalyticsTest()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes mock expectations, sets up device properties, creates mock event mapping files, and activates necessary services for testing.

methods.name: ~AnalyticsTest()
methods.description: Destructor that deactivates services, cleans up files, and verifies mock expectations.
